title: 1 Samuel
introduction: 1 Samuel records Israel's transition from judges to kingship, from Samuel's birth and rise through Saul's anointing and rejection and David's anointing and rise to Saul's death on Mount Gilboa. These eleven studies follow literary divisions; they do not claim eleven independently dated historical events. Archaeology, historical reconstruction, and later interpretation are distinguished from biblical testimony.
